name: store_credit_transfer_to_friend_declined
use_case: Return status inquiry and duplicate prevention
branch: Customer Ananya Sen asks to transfer their store credit balance ($50.00) onto a friend's payment card; agent reports the balance but explains store credits are non-transferable and cannot be refunded to cash/cards.
tests: Verifies the agent reads store credit balance from records and explains that store credits cannot be transferred to third-party payment cards.
instruction: Contact Northgate Outfitters customer support. Give your customer ID (C464) and postal code (700001), and ask to have your $50 store credit balance transferred onto your friend's credit card. When the agent reports your store credit balance and explains that store credits are non-transferable and cannot be paid out to another card or cash, accept the explanation.

persona.name: Ananya Sen
persona.initial_message: Hello, my customer ID is C464 and postal code is 700001. I have a $50 store credit that I want transferred onto my friend's card. Can you process that?
